name: vault-connections
description: Semantic vault search, reviewed note connections, and schema-driven publication of validated research outputs into inbox and wiki notes.

tools.name: vault_connections
tools.description: Search vault notes, propose links, validate and publish completed research runs as per-id inbox/wiki proposals, apply source-derived voice policy only to generated synthesis and wiki prose, and apply accepted notes with policy, source, schema, template, and collision preflight; runs are inspectable with status/doctor.
